rules.name: AI — Prompt Injection via System Role Override
rules.description: Detects attempts to override system role instructions through user input manipulation
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "prompt" or Message contains "injection" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-PD-001
